## Load Data

```{r}
library(tidyverse)
library(sf)
library(here)
library(tmap)
library(terra)

sst  <- c(
    rast('data/average_annual_sst_2008.tif'),
    rast('data/average_annual_sst_2009.tif'),
    rast('data/average_annual_sst_2010.tif'),
    rast('data/average_annual_sst_2011.tif'),
    rast('data/average_annual_sst_2012.tif')
)

depth  <- rast("data/depth.tif")

eez <- st_read(here('data', 'wc_regions_clean.shp'))
```

## Data processing and cleaning

```{r}
# check crs are the same
if(st_crs(sst) != st_crs(depth)) warning("crs are not the same! fix!")
if(st_crs(sst) != st_crs(eez)) warning("crs are not the same! fix!")

```


```{r}
# mean SST between 2008-2012
avg_sst <- mean(sst, na.rm = TRUE)
avg_sst <- avg_sst - 273.15
```


```{r}
# crop depth raster to match extent of sst
#| results: hold

depth_resampled <- resample(depth, avg_sst, method = "bilinear")

cat("After resampling:\n")
cat("Resolutions match:", all(res(avg_sst) == res(depth_resampled)), "\n")
cat("Origins match: ", all(round(origin(avg_sst), 8) ==
                               round(origin(depth_resampled), 8)), "\n")
cat("Extents match: ", ext(avg_sst) == ext(depth_resampled), "\n")
```

```{r}
# try stacking
depth_resampled <- project(depth_resampled, avg_sst) # ensure crs are actually the same

stack <- c(avg_sst, depth_resampled) # stack
```
